# Lab 11.6: Change History: APPENDS & CHANGES

## What We Are Going to Do
Read appended rows in a time window with `APPENDS`, and inserts, updates and deletes with `CHANGES`.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Read appended rows.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT ride_id, city, fare, _CHANGE_TIMESTAMP
FROM APPENDS(TABLE lab11.rides, TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR), NULL)
ORDER BY _CHANGE_TIMESTAMP DESC
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `APPENDS` returns only inserted rows, with the time they were added.

2. **[SQL] Turn on change history.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">ALTER TABLE lab11.rides SET OPTIONS (enable_change_history = TRUE);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Make some changes.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">UPDATE lab11.rides SET fare = fare * 1.1 WHERE city = 'Surat';
DELETE FROM lab11.rides WHERE fare &lt; 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Read all changes.** `CHANGES` needs an end time at least 10 minutes in the past, so run this 10+ minutes after step 3:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT ride_id, city, fare, _CHANGE_TYPE, _CHANGE_TIMESTAMP
FROM CHANGES(TABLE lab11.rides,
             TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR),
             TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 601 SECOND))
ORDER BY _CHANGE_TIMESTAMP;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Updates show as a `DELETE` of the old row and an `INSERT` of the new one.

5. **[CLI] Count changes by type.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT _CHANGE_TYPE, COUNT(*) FROM CHANGES(TABLE lab11.rides, TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR), TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 601 SECOND)) GROUP BY 1'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `APPENDS` | Inserted rows in a time window |
| `CHANGES` | Inserts, updates and deletes |
| Requirement | `enable_change_history = TRUE` for CHANGES |
| Window | Limited by the time travel window |
